p.src: 1  The LORD reigns! Let the earth rejoice! Let the multitude of islands be glad!

en: The LORD reigns! Let the earth rejoice! Let the multitude of islands be glad!
u.src: 1  The LORD reigns! Let the earth rejoice! Let the multitude of islands be glad!

p.src: 2  Clouds and darkness are around him. Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.

en: Clouds and darkness are around him. Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.
u.src: 2  Clouds and darkness are around him. Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.

p.src: 3  A fire goes before him, and burns up his adversaries on every side.

en: A fire goes before him, and burns up his adversaries on every side.
u.src: 3  A fire goes before him, and burns up his adversaries on every side.

p.src: 4  His lightning lights up the world. The earth sees, and trembles.

en: His lightning lights up the world. The earth sees, and trembles.
u.src: 4  His lightning lights up the world. The earth sees, and trembles.

p.src: 5  The mountains melt like wax at the presence of the LORD, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.

en: The mountains melt like wax at the presence of the LORD, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.
u.src: 5  The mountains melt like wax at the presence of the LORD, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.

p.src: 6  The heavens declare his righteousness. All the peoples have seen his glory.

en: The heavens declare his righteousness. All the peoples have seen his glory.
u.src: 6  The heavens declare his righteousness. All the peoples have seen his glory.

p.src: 7  Let all them be shamed who serve engraved images, who boast in their idols. Worship him, all you gods!

en: Let all them be shamed who serve engraved images, who boast in their idols. Worship him, all you gods!
u.src: 7  Let all them be shamed who serve engraved images, who boast in their idols. Worship him, all you gods!

p.src: 8  Zion heard and was glad. The daughters of Judah rejoiced because of your judgments, LORD.

en: Zion heard and was glad. The daughters of Judah rejoiced because of your judgments, LORD.
u.src: 8  Zion heard and was glad. The daughters of Judah rejoiced because of your judgments, LORD.

p.src: 9  For you, LORD, are most high above all the earth. You are exalted far above all gods.

en: For you, LORD, are most high above all the earth. You are exalted far above all gods.
u.src: 9  For you, LORD, are most high above all the earth. You are exalted far above all gods.

p.src: 10  You who love the LORD, hate evil! He preserves the souls of his saints. He delivers them out of the hand of the wicked.

en: You who love the LORD, hate evil! He preserves the souls of his saints. He delivers them out of the hand of the wicked.
u.src: 10  You who love the LORD, hate evil! He preserves the souls of his saints. He delivers them out of the hand of the wicked.

p.src: 11  Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.

en: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.
u.src: 11  Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.

p.src: 12  Be glad in the LORD, you righteous people! Give thanks to his holy Name.

en: Be glad in the LORD, you righteous people! Give thanks to his holy Name.
u.src: 12  Be glad in the LORD, you righteous people! Give thanks to his holy Name.
